chapters.title: 1. Trump posts The Great Powers 1945, 2026, pairing himself, Xi and Putin with Yalta's Big Three — Is peace secured by great powers dividing the world among themselves, or does a just order require that small nations have a voice in their own fate?

2. Democrats split over using the Dec. 11 funding deadline to force an end to the Iran war — Who decides when a nation goes to war, and how far may a legislature go to stop one it never authorized: is withholding funds principled restraint or a dangerous gamble with the common good?

3. Grand Theft Auto VI launches with a record $3.79 billion day, reopening the old fight over violent games — Does art that depicts vice teach vice, or let us see it clearly? What we love shapes who we become.

4. Christian nationalists see an opening in GOP midterm losses as Christians argue over two kingdoms — What is the proper relation between the City of God and the City of Man: should faith shape the laws, or stay free of the state?
